caption: The drawing depicts an arched doorway set into a stone wall. The doorway is framed by detailed architectural elements, including an arch with decorative moldings and keystone at the top center. The surface of the wall is depicted in faded blue-gray tones, with large patches of exposed, yellowish-brown brickwork showing through areas where the plaster has chipped away. The stones forming the wall around the door are rectangular and uneven, with some cracks and imperfections illustrated. The archway itself is a light beige color, with no visible door present, only a blank surface filling the arch. The composition is centered with the doorway occupying most of the drawing, and the background is plain, with no additional objects or scenery. The artist's signature appears in the lower right corner.
title: Stone Doorway, Carved
cluster: #12 — Spanish Colonial Art of the Southwest
